description: Standard reproducible evaluation template for capturing QCET Plan Executor telemetry and computing regression deltas against baseline benchmarks.

run.description: Execution run evaluating v1.1 executor on master UX consolidation plan

comparison.verdictRationale: Full requirement coverage preserved (100%), 0 ownership violations, 9.1% wall-clock reduction, and 9.4% token efficiency gain with 0 correctness regressions.

comparisonRules.uncoveredRequirements: true if run.requirementsCovered < run.requirementsTotal or run.requirementsCovered < baseline.requirementsCovered
comparisonRules.correctnessRegressed: true if run.globalValidation !== 'pass' or run.finalStatus === 'BLOCKED' or run.metrics.correctness.unresolvedFindings > 0

verdictEvaluation.REGRESSION_DETECTED: Any regression flag is true, or any zero-tolerance invariant violated
verdictEvaluation.IMPROVEMENT: All regression flags are false, zero-tolerance invariants pass, and deltaWallClockPct <= -5.0 or deltaTokensPct <= -5.0 without correctness regressions
verdictEvaluation.PASS: All regression flags are false, zero-tolerance invariants pass, and metrics remain within acceptable baseline budget tolerances

fieldDefinitions.plan: Relative path to the plan file executed
fieldDefinitions.executorVersion: Semantic version or milestone identifier of the executor code (e.g. v1.1, v1.2, v1.3, v1.4, v1.5)
fieldDefinitions.wallClockMs: Total end-to-end execution wall-clock time in milliseconds
fieldDefinitions.calibrationDurationMs: Time spent in pre-execution calibration and manifest synthesis
fieldDefinitions.shards: Total number of execution shards generated in manifest
fieldDefinitions.agents: Total count of subagents spawned throughout the run
fieldDefinitions.peakConcurrent: Maximum number of subagents running simultaneously
fieldDefinitions.tokens: Total prompt and completion tokens consumed
fieldDefinitions.requirementsTotal: Total explicit requirements declared in plan or decomposed manifest
fieldDefinitions.requirementsCovered: Total requirements formally verified by skeptics and release gate
fieldDefinitions.ownershipViolations: Number of files modified by shards outside their designated owns whitelist
fieldDefinitions.verificationFindings: Total defects or gaps flagged during shard and integration verification
fieldDefinitions.findingsConfirmed: Number of flagged issues confirmed as real bugs requiring repair
fieldDefinitions.repairRounds: Total repair loops executed across all shards and integration phases
fieldDefinitions.blockedShards: Number of shards that ended in an unresolved or blocked state
fieldDefinitions.globalValidation: Result of global repo-wide checks ('pass' or 'fail')
fieldDefinitions.baselineRunId: The runId of the baseline benchmark record against which this run is compared
